subject.title: [Feature]: read-only channel mode (inbound only, no outbound)

question: Should OpenClaw add a hard no-outbound channel/account mode, and should that contract be shared channel/plugin SDK capability, WhatsApp-owned account config, or external protocol isolation such as wacli?
rationale: Current source proves the feature is still missing, but related PR review shows the durable security/config boundary is a maintainer product/API choice rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Design shared channel contract
options.body: Define a shared outbound-suppression contract for channel/plugin implementations, then ship WhatsApp as the first implementation with tests and live proof.

options.title: Approve WhatsApp account readOnly
options.body: Accept a WhatsApp-specific account config as a first slice, with clear docs that it is not yet a cross-channel SDK contract.

options.title: Delegate to external isolation
options.body: Decline core/plugin config for now and document a supported passive-monitoring path through external protocol isolation such as wacli.

recommendation.title: Design shared channel contract
recommendation.body: Define a shared outbound-suppression contract for channel/plugin implementations, then ship WhatsApp as the first implementation with tests and live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They provided the clearest maintainer-side review signal on the closest implementation and raised the exact shared-contract versus WhatsApp-only decision.
